data.description: Arif Habib Limited is a public listed company incorporated in Pakistan under the repealed Companies Ordinance, 1984 which has now been replaced by Companies Act, 2017. The Company was initially incorporated as an unquoted public limited company wholly owned by Arif Habib Corporation Limited. The principal activities of the Company are investments, share brokerage, inter-bank brokerage, Initial Public Offer (IPO) underwriting, advisory and consultancy services.
